code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_seps = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    cb = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    cells = [[grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in row_seps
              for c in range(w) if c not in col_seps]]
    counts = Counter(cells[0])
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    signal = next(v for v in counts if v != background)
    marker = next((v for v in counts if v not in (background, signal)), None)
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        outrow = []
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1])
                    for c in range(cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1])]
            outrow.append((marker if marker is not None else signal) if vals.count(signal) == 2 else background)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
'''
